page_desc: Explore our training and coaching across entrepreneurship, professional and personal development, and artificial intelligence.
individuals_heading: A step-by-step path to starting your business.
individuals_desc: Our programmes are for people who are done thinking about starting and ready to actually do it. Most of our participants are busy. They have jobs, families, and limited time. Our structure is built around that reality.
accelerator_desc: Learn everything you need to start a business — on your own time, at your own pace. Pre-recorded video lessons that walk you through every step, from testing your idea to getting your first paying client.
dwy_desc: Build your business with an experienced founder right beside you. This is hands-on. You will be coached, challenged, and held to account every week — from your first idea through to your first paying client.
dfy_desc: Learn how to understand and use AI in practical ways. From getting familiar with AI tools to improving productivity and applying AI in work, business and everyday life, we help people develop the knowledge and confidence to make use of this technology.
organisations_desc: We work with businesses, universities, councils, charities and other organisations to help employees, students, participants and communities develop useful skills.
partners_heading: Clear delivery. Measurable results. Proper reporting.
cta_heading: Ready to talk about a programme for your community?
cta_desc: Tell us who you are trying to help, what you want to achieve, and when you need it. We will come back to you with a proposal.
individuals_section_heading: Find the training that's right for you.
individuals_section_desc: Whether you're starting something new, developing skills you already have or exploring new opportunities, our training covers a range of practical subjects.
p1_desc: Learn how to start, build and develop a business. From understanding your market and creating a business plan to finding customers and managing your business, we offer practical training, workshops and coaching to help you move forward.
p1_learn_1: How to validate a business idea and identify a market willing to pay
p1_learn_2: How to design an offer that solves a real problem at a price people accept
p1_learn_3: How to sell with confidence — even if you have never sold before
p1_learn_4: How to build a lead generation system that works with limited time and budget
p1_learn_5: How to set up the operational foundations of a real, functioning business
p1_for_1: People with a business idea who need structure to make it real
p1_for_2: Anyone tired of consuming content that never leads to action
p1_for_3: People with limited time who need a focused, practical path they can follow in short bursts
p1_leave_1: A validated business concept with a defined target market
p1_leave_2: A complete offer ready to take to market
p1_leave_3: Sales scripts and outreach frameworks you can use immediately
p1_leave_4: A marketing plan tailored to your situation and budget
p1_leave_5: A clear operational roadmap for your first 90 days
p2_desc: Develop the skills to communicate clearly, lead effectively and work confidently with others. Our training covers leadership, management, negotiation, public speaking, confidence and other skills that can make a difference in your professional and personal life.
p2_includes_1: Weekly live sessions with direct coaching and feedback
p2_includes_2: Daily accountability tracking and performance reviews
p2_includes_3: One-to-one support on your specific business challenges
p2_includes_4: Templated frameworks, scripts, and systems you implement as you go
p2_includes_5: A structured curriculum that builds week-on-week toward launch
p2_for_1: People who want hands-on guidance, not just information
p2_for_2: Anyone committed to launching within the programme window
p2_for_3: People who know they need accountability to follow through
p2_leave_1: A launched and operating business — not a plan, an actual business
p2_leave_2: Paying clients acquired during the programme
p2_leave_3: Tested sales processes and proven outreach systems
p2_leave_4: A 90-day growth plan for continued momentum after graduation
p2_leave_5: Ongoing access to the Mind and Method community
p3_does_1: Register your business and set up the legal foundations
p3_does_2: Build your brand, website, and online presence
p3_does_3: Create your offer, pricing, and sales materials
p3_does_4: Set up and run paid advertising to get your first clients
p3_does_5: Connect you with accountants, legal support, and business finance
p3_for_1: People who want a business but do not have the time to build it themselves
p3_for_2: People who want to skip the learning curve and start with a running operation
p3_for_3: People who are ready to invest in having it done properly from day one
p3_leave_2: A complete brand and online presence
p3_leave_3: A tested offer with paying clients
p3_leave_4: Advertising systems running and generating leads
p3_leave_5: Full handover with everything you need to operate independently
organisations_heading: Practical training for the people you support.
sector_universities: Training for students and staff, covering entrepreneurship, employability, leadership, communication and practical AI skills.
sector_councils: Training that supports workforce development, enterprise initiatives and community programmes, helping people develop skills for work, business and everyday life.
sector_charities: Practical workshops and coaching for staff, volunteers and the communities they serve, covering areas such as communication, confidence, entrepreneurship and AI literacy.
sector_prisons: Accessible training that helps participants develop practical business skills, communication and confidence, supporting preparation for employment, self-employment and new opportunities.
sector_schools: Age-appropriate workshops that introduce young people to entrepreneurship, communication, confidence and practical skills they can build on as they develop.
sector_corporate: Training for employees and teams in leadership, management, communication, negotiation and practical AI, helping people develop skills they can apply in their roles.
expect_1: What participants understand before and after training, assessed through questions, activities or short knowledge checks.
expect_2: What participants can demonstrate through exercises, completed tasks or practical activities.
expect_3: How confident participants feel about using their new skills, measured through feedback or before-and-after assessments.
expect_4: Attendance, engagement and completion rates, where these are relevant to the programme's objectives.
expect_5: How participants put their learning into practice, whether through improved communication, leadership, productivity or other practical applications.
expect_6: How participants apply AI tools to relevant tasks, including improvements in how they work or complete activities.
expect_7: Progress towards agreed business-building milestones, such as testing an idea, developing a business plan or preparing to launch.
expect_8: Participant feedback, areas for improvement and opportunities for further learning or support.
partners_section_heading: How can we measure success together?
cta_section_heading: Looking for training for yourself or others?
cta_section_desc: Whether you'd like to join a workshop, explore coaching or arrange training for your employees, students or community, we'd be happy to hear from you.
page_desc2: We offer established workshops, courses and coaching for individuals and organisations, alongside bespoke training designed around an organisation's specific needs.
p1_desc2: Business Builder is one of our established entrepreneurship programmes.
organisations_desc2: Whether you're looking for entrepreneurship education, professional development or practical AI training, we offer established programmes and training tailored to your organisation's needs.
partners_section_desc: The right measures depend on the people you're training and what you want them to achieve. We can work with you to agree suitable outcomes and ways to assess progress.
